notes.title: All Aboard! Exciting news awaits you...
notes.content:
[h1] [b]⛵We are sailing into 1.0 on Oct 11th '25!![/b][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/9779951b9cde5382664db2da07bf36290dd597c8.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]👫Made by gamers, for gamers![/b][/h2][p]We are a husband-wife team of 2. We are both gamers and game devs. Forgotten Seas is a game made by gamers, for gamers! From the outset, our community provided essential feedback and an endless stream of ideas that helped us realize our vision. This game is a passion project that feels larger than life!  [/p][p][/p][h2][b]💎What improvements were made since Early Access[/b] [/h2][p]We have added significant content throughout our Early Access course. Some of the main gameplay additions include:
[/p][h3]🌴 [b]Graphics & Performance[/b][/h3][p]Aside from a major graphic overhaul to bring you beautiful tropical scenery [i](lush blue waters, vibrant landscape, and cozy dwellings)[/i], we have also made performance improvements that make for smooth gameplay in a dynamic world where players can place their own buildings amidst countless other mechanics at play. 

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/96b2e26858be58768063d965961fbe03aac2f8ee.png"][/img][/p][h3]⚓ [b]Crew & Community[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Crew recruitment, township building, and management systems[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded base-building to create safe havens[/p][/*][/list][h3]🗺️ [b]Exploration & Adventure[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Fully developed map system[/p][/*][*][p]Treasure hunting, collection, and display mechanics[/p][/*][*][p]New adventures across the high seas[/p][/*][/list][h3]🚢 [b]Sailing & Combat[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Sailing skill progression system[/p][/*][*][p]More naval combat encounters and on-foot battles[/p][/*][*][p]Additional ships to master and command[/p][/*][/list][h3]📦 [b]Economy & Objectives[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Commodity trading and delivery missions[/p][/*][*][p]More layered gameplay loops to discover[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p]Forgotten Seas is a game of chill and thrill. You can seek as adventurous a thrill as you like, or lie back in your hammock on your self-made tropical dock, and sip lemonade while growing your own hops and crops!  [/p][h2]
[b]What to Expect for 1.0:[/b][/h2][p][i][b]Check out our New Trailer![/b][/i][/p][previewyoutube="eQXQSytz3Wo;full"][/previewyoutube][p]The full 1.0 release combines all of these additions with a fundamental overhaul of the game's graphics, performance, and an endless list of tweaks made in collaboration with the community. It's a true adventure on the high seas, with a carefully tuned sailing experience, intense combat both across the waves and on dry land, a robust skill system, and precious treasures to hunt down, collect, and display as players attempt to solve the mystery of the Bermuda Void.  
[/p][h2][b]⚓We are not done[/b][/h2][p]While we may be sailing into 1.0, we are not done! 1.0 means there will be a 1.1, 1.2, ...and 2.0!  While some may think that 1.0 marks an end.  "1.0" in the software engineering world means - a new beginning. We have more parts of the story planned, new biomes, new features, new improvements, and new adventures that await.   There are several things you can do in our game! [/p][p][/p][p][b][i]Here are a few ideas:[/i][/b][/p][h3][b]⛵Craft a "Ship-In-A-Bottle"[/b] [/h3][p]It all begins with a bottle! Lost deep inside the Bermuda Triangle, discover the art of shrinking a ship into a bottle. You can summon a ship from a bottle at an opportune moment, and put it back in the bottle if needed! [/p][p] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/8118e22a260a77a991662c59a85da2d7c916ad33.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]🏴‍☠️ Build mighty ships and rule the seas[/b] [/h3][p]Craft a fleet of ships and sail into the mysterious adventures that await you. Battle the Pirates and the Seas! Be it to find your way out, or to forge your own destiny in this mysterious realm.  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/1f24282a9b1f08317e5345aa2fa3a3b24da6c0ba.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]💎Build a Township and trade goods[/b] [/h3][p]Establish a township and manage crew, trade and manufacture goods. grow farms, build treasuries, run bars and more!   [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/52e4f33ed34c6f594a1055325bbec71f80eb949c.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]🏠⚓Build a cozy tropical base and docks![/b][/h3][p]With new improvements to our base building, you can now build even more creative dwellings.  Our building system is designed to blend in with tropical waters with a full dock and farm.  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/d759f42c727dbedf7cbf156dcb727094d12304f1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]🌴🌊Join the party at the beaches of Forgotten Seas![/b][/h3][p]Don't forget to wishlist the game and join our [url="https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.gg%2FrKggqBZ9P4"]Discord Community[/url] to celebrate the launch together!  [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/77400651d89e7c039488ad5a0f5efc81bddbc4c4.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]👫A big thank you from Pangea Game Studios[/b][/h3][p]We are a small two-person, family-run game studio. Your support and kind consideration has gone a long way to fuel our passion and creativity. We are developing the game with you — hop on aboard!  [/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2168260/Forgotten_Seas/"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Maintenance and Bug Fix Patch
notes.content:
[h3]Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] VSYNC and Buffering options are now available in the FPS settings on the home screen
[*] VSYNC or triple buffering can help those who experience screen tearing from monitor refresh rate related issues. 
However, please be advised that using VSYNC on multiple simultaneous applications can cause screen freezing or white-screen crashes. As a general tip, If you are alt-tabbing between different applications, consider turning vsync OFF.
[*] Optimized some more Shaders for dynamic lighting
[*] Xbox controllers are now automatically detected when plugged in, and the correct default configuration is applied. For other controllers, you may need to activate steam input separately as we are still in the process of optimizing partial controller support.

[*] Quest “Restore Crew Haven” now retroactively finishes for all other players on multiplayer if any player on a server clears the rubbles.
[*] Fixed an issue where Maple syrup taps were not interactable via mouse clicks if placed close to other syrup taps.
[*] Maple Syrup tap now properly shows the time remaining on collecting Maple Syrup.
[*] Clam and Crab harvester ranges have been increased. Your crew will now harvest clams and crabs without needing the presence of the captain as long as job orders are given.
[*] Windmill, Iron Stove, Advanced Fermenters, and Advanced Aging Barrels have had their ranges increased
[*] Fixed an animation issue with the shovel where the sound and effects were not timed properly
[*] Pickup animation now only plays once every second to avoid glitching when someone spams the F key to pick up something nearby.
[*] Fixed an issue where the sprint ability was taking too much energy at a higher energy pool (when more points were added to the energy stat).
[*] Added some smoothing when player character turns instead of flipping instantly towards the direction of motion
[*] Fixed a bug where Chairs were taking damage during the storms
[*] The stats panel background in the inventory window is changed to display the stats a bit more clearly.
[*] The Quest Journey Home Part 1 is now available at the Shady Trader
[*] The Quest Obtain a Treasure Map is now given when someone breaks the lost chest at the Crash site  for the first time.
[*] The in- game journal has been updated to include a new Trading tab with more information to come on Trading and Trade deliveries.
[/list]

notes.content:
[list]

[*] A 10 second heads up notification is now shown when world save is about to happen.

You will now see increased framerates while sailing in the ocean.

Thanks to everyone who contributed their save files to help optimize the world better for base builders and combat enthusiasts alike!

We are a very small team of 2, working on a project that is larger than life. We are committed to making this game all it can be!

Cheers!
Cpt Anne

notes.title: The Crew Haven — Let the Trades Begin!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=kYDNUzS8nLE;full][/previewyoutube]
ːsteamthisːCheck out the video above for a sneak peek of the update ːsteamthisː

[h3]New Trading and Building Island — Crew Haven [/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/2a5698361430039c33976c9cd56bb1f6e1b15f6a.png[/img]

[h4]Restore the Haven and start trade and delivery operations![/h4]

New repeatable Trading and Delivery objectives.
New repeatable Seek and Destroy objectives.
New Crew Buildings.

[h4]Trade Crates[/h4]
Collect and manufacture Trade Crates after restoring your crew buildings at the Crew Haven.
Deliver Trade Goods to remote ports and earn Dubloons!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/93f341e5862f56c4bc0fbe1de839b762042a76c6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/93b19af2834e74f0e410bdc46ef04ba8a61caf21.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/81c659a388e799512bd586c82e2e67db0085a041.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/2171bb363281560a0cc3f4d89c902e89c0431398.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/6da666ce97bef81efe5c83810f9b81c5c3f01fb3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/15f9ba103ff7adc5a4f8deb4c4d0e4ba7934b51a.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/e2c3d85c9e03ba5a16ee5634d35295a0d40d6778.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/17e7d8b4f864548ed101ab8106abbc1fae1a66cd.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/80a177465bb1c560ce06d8a75b87c2aef9067a45.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/3d215fa17ee454efcf67eace68faf43b321193fc.png[/img][/url]
Check your objectives for a mission to Travel to Crew Haven (at level 21) to get started. 

[h3]Supply and Demand[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/43ca47ebb390b82e4f8a828c4c0f2257271d0a4e.jpg[/img]
Different Trade crates are in demand every day. Check the Crew Haven Board “Trade Goods shop” to find the Trade Crates that are in demand by the Northwest and Southwest Trade ports for that day.Trade Crates can be acquired either by manufacturing them in your new Crew Buildings or by putting a security deposit in the Trade Goods shop. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/91ab8dc76684f550d0f8b9aac02e9485538b71e2.jpg[/img]

[h3]Crew Buildings[/h3]

Crew buildings can be obtained in the Dubloon Shop at the Crew Haven Board. Crew Buildings can be placed in the Town Square (central area) of Crew Haven Island. When you try to place the building, you will see arrows that will guide you to the correct installation location. 

You can earn Dubloons by doing some objectives at the board. Some simple objectives may reward you your first Dubloons, which can then be used to expand your operations further. To get started with the Trading operations, you may need to obtain your first Trade Crates from the Crew Haven Board Trade Goods Shop. Once you successfully deliver these Trade Crates to their respective ports, you will be rewarded. Once a delivery objective is accepted, you will see the map markers on your compass, or in the map by pressing M.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/9906b9bec5996eec43e00d474c2e3068ce81ed82.png[/img]

There are different kinds of crew buildings. Each building has its own benefit, and each building creates its own kind of unique products, with some additional benefit. For example, Crew Farm grows coffee, and the Crew Brewery makes a Mauby base used for making Mauby (a new drink). You can sell some drinks at the Crew Bar and make some Gold and Dubloons as a side hustle!

[h4]Crew Work Orders[/h4]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/e7aceaa970966a5133ec7429f34b26a211da3d95.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/87d6e9c01f891cb02dcfe4df18bc04fff41bb684.png[/img][/url]

Crew buildings run on Crew  Work Orders that need to be crafted. Check your player crafting or your workbench to create new Work Orders. This item can be crafted with both "C" crafting menu and the Workbench. Crew Work Orders are used to keep production running in the Crew Buildings. Place the Work Orders in the storage of your crew buildings, and the crew will start working!

[h4]Treasury Building[/h4]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/4554ca98b9d44ba94911a3a145f82269d30ddff7.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/ab75f18033e4791dcd30c0733e1e5164fde868dd.png[/img][/url]
Display your treasures and earn Treasury Bills. Installing a Treasury Building is a good way to earn some passive income on the side. Display Treasures you find hidden deep inside a Pyramid, or treasures swallowed by pet Krakens that steal shiny things! New Treasury building can be placed in the Crew Haven town. Place treasures found from the Pyramid and Beast loot to generate Treasury Bills. The Treasury Bills can be turned in at Captain Nyx for rewards.

New [b]Crew Work Boats and Crew Shipyard[/b] can be placed at the dock at Crew Haven. The Shipyard will craft Pangea Defender Ships for Sir Jim in exchange for rewards.

[h3]An Ocean Beast Rises…[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/df1fd34760e85ffbfa3f494dfa8b3c7e38799625.jpg[/img]

A new Beast Invasion will now haunt the Forgotten Seas. Beast will rise near Crew Haven and can be destroyed by both melee weapons and ship cannonballs. These beasts are known to steal treasures and can hold swallowed treasure caches in their bellies! Obtained a swallowed treasure cache for a chance at finding rare treasures and display them in your Treasury Building.

[h4]Commander Half-Life & his Cargo Stealin' Thugs Encounter[/h4]

[previewyoutube=93A2ioPq3Lk;leftthumb][/previewyoutube][b]Commander Half Life[/b] is the leader of the cargo stealers. He spawns when you accept a [b]Dangerous Delivery[/b] Objective. Dangerous Delivery is a mission for those who wish for a challenge. Beware, this mission will put most of your skills to the test. Most important skill for this encounter is your “Navigation Skill” that improves your speed and handling of your ship. Commander Half Life can only be defeated by outmaneuvering his ship. More details will be available in your objective. You can see your objectives in the Journal [J] or Objectives [O]. 

[h4]New Cargo Stealers![/h4]
Beware! Some Cargo Stealer ships may block your path. They are notorious thugs led by their Commander Half Life! They will try to steal your trade crates, and any valuables you may be carrying on you or your ship. If your cargo is stolen, the cargo stealer will try to run away. You can recover your stolen cargo by destroying the thief. You will need to hurry as the cargo stealer may get away and you may lose your crates and other valuable goods. 

[h3]New “Navigation” Skill[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/7016dc8fad068fac5f532c98d309cbf2ef5bce07.jpg[/img]

The New Navigation skill improves your speed and handling with each level. You can increase the level of your navigation skill by collecting [b]Navigation Skill Pages[/b] and [b]Navigation Charts[/b].

[h4]Navigation Skill Pages and Navigation Charts[/h4]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/eaca36854b506e29dd2e12b8dc9a14197d8c1044.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/99c7b02f8b3275ce260c5668c54bb247743f1235.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/00c31e126f098ee3e831e702591456459b29bc3d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/08cf46fde2674aeb45e7ec2bc87794803365a3d5.png[/img][/url]
Navigation Skill pages can be obtained by the new Interactive Wind and Sail Management system. Align your sails to the correct “Point-Of-Sail” when prompted to do so in the course of your sailing. When you match your ship sails to the prompted Point-Of-Sail direction, you have a chance to receive a skill page. When you match your sail to the proper direction, you will receive a speed buff as well. Navigation Charts can be obtained at the Dubloon Shop in the Crew Haven board.
Collect enough pages and charts to make a Navigation Skill Book and enhance your skill!

[h4]New Interactive Wind System and adjustable “Point-Of-Sail”[/h4]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/f3409d05c9bac4b53b3d483b86c88b76ea65f967.jpg[/img]
Turn and adjust your sails to the proper Point-Of-Sail orientation to gain an advantage. You can find this in the ship HUD (bottom left corner of the screen). When prompted to do so, align your sails correctly for a wind buff akin to the point-of-sail direction. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/5aeead30c1253d7cddf08249f330b0082869b938.jpg[/img]
For example, if the wind system shows a Starboard Tack (Wind blowing from the Starboard Side), the sails will need to be turned a few degrees clockwise to catch the proper wind. Doing so will give you a wind buff and a chance to obtain a Navigation Skill Page. Such an advantage is extremely helpful in new encounters such as the Commander Half Life encounter.

[h3]Mermaid Buffs[/h3]
Mermaids give significant sailing speeds when you brush by them with your ship. Mermaids may also give you health and energy, and leave you some gifts from time to time. If you happen to spot a mermaid, be sure to swing by and say hello! Mermaid buffs can be great at times when you desperately need energy or health, or when there is no wind. Mermaid buffs can also provide a crucial speed advantage in fighting your enemies. Mermaid buffs are generally short lived bursts, but when timed aptly, they can be a great ally.

[h3]New Kitchen and Kitchen Decorations[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/2ac77ef771d1bc50a528293d91aecef75f790e7d.png[/img]
New Kitchen is now available in the Dubloon Shop. While it doesn’t cook anything new, it lists most recipes for you, so you don’t have to remember the processing details should you choose to. However, if you enjoy discovering recipes on your own, you can still continue to use the stoves and campfire the way you are used to.

New decorations like hanging spices, cheese, meats etc are now also available for the base builder and decorator enthusiasts.

[h3]New Drinks Coffee and Mauby[/h3]
Coffee provides a significant energy regeneration buff and Mauby increases your thirst pool and provides you a shot of energy. New Coffee Pot to brew Coffee is available in the Dubloon Shop. To make coffee, coffee must first be grown at the Crew Farm by adding Crew Work Orders to the Crew Farm after installation. Coffee can be consumed to gain energy and can also be packed at the Packing Workbench to sell in the Forest Market Stall.

New Mauby drinks can be made in the fermenters. To make Mauby, a Mauby base is required. Mauve base can be obtained from the Crew Brewery by adding Crew Work Orders to the Crew Brewery. Mauby can be consumed for energy and thirst and can also be packed at the Packing Workbench to sell in the Tropical Market Stall.

[h3]New item: Ship Insurance[/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/62c2740a44c06119941a1b34f81e409897f021f6.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/c0f96d99a469339fdaf3d765782cc3342afe5226.png[/img][/url]
Place one Ship Insurance in your ship inventory. If your ship is destroyed, it will be recovered in your Vault in Fort Pangea. Ship Insurance can be obtained from the Crew Haven Board.

[h3]Other Changes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Harvestable Trees (e.g. Coconut Trees) will no longer spawn on your foundations.
[*] Improvements to lighting torches and other light fixtures
You may need to replace some light fixtures as now less light fixtures are required to light up your base. If you are using too many torches or lamps, consider replacing them with fewer light fixtures. Avoid using too many free standing torches and wall mounted lights in the same area, consider using fewer of them.
[*] After teleporting or respawning from a faraway location, your base will now be loaded quicker than before.
[*]New Trade Ports added on Northwest and Southwest locations on the map.
[*]New Currency "Dubloons".
[*]Added some new items such as Crew Supplies and Sea Biscuits to the loot tables of Pirate enemies.
[*]New decor including banners, food shelves and signs.
[*]Defend Fort Pangea encounter now also awards some Crew Supplies.
[*]New Clam and Crab Harvesters to place on shallow waters. Obtainable at Crew Haven.
[/list]

[h2]Summer Sale![/h2]
Be sure to take advantage of the current Summer Sale and get the game! The oceans await your presence!

[h3]A Note from your Devs[/h3]
👧 We are a small, family-run, Indie Dev Team of 2 🧑 
We do not have the resources of larger teams and larger game studios. We are developing a game with a big scope and larger than life expectations. It is going to take time and your support. Forgotten Seas is in Early Access, and still under development. We have big plans! In time we will make this game all it can be! 

🙏 [b]Reviews[/b] are the bread and butter of us small Indies! Please leave us your honest reviews 🙏
🤟 [b]A special thanks[/b] to all our players, backers and supporters - you all ROCK 🤟

We have a friendly and helpful community. Hop on board this incredible journey!

[h3]X Marks The Spot! [/h3]

[h4]Be a Treasure Hunter and collect Timeless Relics![/h4]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/bfef74d0bc2bca6167441116ab267167233101c6.png[/img]

[list]
[*] New [b]Repeatable Treasure Hunting [/b] objectives that pay Gold and Stamps.
[*] Discover New Relics and complete your collection.
[*] Combine new Treasure Clues to craft Treasure Maps.
[/list]
Collect [b]Treasure Clues[/b] hidden across the Bermuda Triangle to put together Treasure maps.
[b]Check your crafting recipes[/b] in Player Crafting and Workbenches to combine treasure clues.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/f3e060dc98a0e3fb9372591362587a645ab12071.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/82bde357c637df2453ee8d2dfb8e8c7a95566f75.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/246eca85e05e5227f7416d73bebefadf92d74c3a.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/b651154c708df5014ee43b4939f18c018ef3a4b9.png[/img][/url]

[b]Click and Use[/b] the Treasure Map to place an 'X' on the map in a random location. Press [M] to see the location on the map. 

[h4]Mysterious Relics[/h4] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/2500a7d2b93ec9bc75d3108921d68f6ba90b2e63.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/73f4ffe39dd1189193d2c4e728f4d398e9ba27cd.png[/img][/url]

Mysterious Relics maybe found when digging up the Treasure in the X Marks the Spot objective.
Sail to the marked location with a shovel and dig up the treasure to find Mysterious Relics or more treasure clues! [b]Click and Use[/b] the Mysterious Relic to reveal a [b]Random Rare Collectible Relic[/b]. 

Treasure Clues drop from Common and Rare Treasure Caches, Trade Blockade Ships, Flotsams, Enemy Ports, Coffer drops from the sky, Smugglers, and Scavengers etc. Lost Chest on starter island gives a guaranteed Treasure Clue and a Shovel to get you started!

[h3]New Treasure Display Shelf [/h3]

Craft a New [b]Treasure Display Shelf[/b] to display all your collected Relics and trigger achievements. Exchange any surplus Relics for gold at a Trader. Collect a set of several Relics hidden across the map and place them inside the Treasure Display Shelf. 

The Relics that are displayed in the Treasure Display Shelf do have a [b]main story quest[/b] significance that is yet to be revealed. You may want to discover and hold on to at least 1 set of Relics and sell or exchange the surplus Relics at a Trader or give to a friend. 


[h3]New Salvager Ship (The Sloop) [/h3]
A new ship in a bottle to behold! The Salvager, a sloop class ship designed to fit perfectly with your treasure hunting desires. [b]Increased loot pickup range, agility, cargo and speed[/b]. While not a ship fitted for heavy combat, it can hold its own in small skirmishes. Fast and agile enough to catch up with Smugglers, and [b]takes significantly reduced damage when on the run[/b]! Its purpose is to treasure hunt, and run away before too many enemies overwhelm you. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/21f3b86f041cb543f961278f428a6d570bd9107a.png[/img]

[list]
[*] This ship can be obtained in Sir Jim’s shop for stamps.
[*] It can also obtained by finishing a new Quest: Sir Jim’s Ship In A Bottle.
[*] This ship has bonus to [b]Fire Damage and has Bonus Resistance to Physical Damage[/b]
[/list]

[h3] Inertia is now enabled on Boats [/h3]

We know that boats don’t start and stop on a whim. We had this disabled in our early development phase to keep things simple for performance and networking reasons. Our goal is to keep boat navigation and controls overall simple and intuitive, but a little immersion is also good for gameplay. We have enabled a small amount of non-intrusive inertia on all boats. Boat movement control will overall feel a bit more natural and smoother, but not cumbersome. Be advised, this feature is enabled on [b]Single Player[/b] mode only.

[h3] Improved Handing, Storage and Pickup Range on All Ships[/h3]

[list]
[*] Better Pickup Range on all boats, and Better Handling and Turning
[*] You can Pick up nearby items in the ocean from an increased ranged by pressing the F key while mounted. 
[*] More Storage slots in Ships, Players and Chests
[/list]

[h3] Shrink the Ship Back Into The Bottle![/h3]
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/38a01b34a2f7cdc6dd4ff07b07f6347b03e82410.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/8fd7a1097ffa46d7136cef816959b0b6cf5df4b3.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/1f850dc82962e208baca6e69079b0b8cd92e8464.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/ca96929e4ca2c9340169d12ff5989a4765046945.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/bd53168d4f3ad688b3f60971a17873f02d7f404b.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/b85766544ddbe8dfeb6adf4e295c7498a047cac4.png[/img][/url]

Apollo (The Shady Trader) now sells an item, the [b]“Ship Shrinker”[/b]. You can now shrink your ship back in the bottle should you desire. To shrink your ship, simply put the item in the ship’s cargo hold (aka  inventory). 

Ship Shrinker will only work if your ship has [i]no missing health[/i]. As in you may not be able to shrink it in combat or when taking damage in battle. However, if you can run away from enemies and heal your ship to full. You can shrink it back. Any cargo in the hold will be sent to your vault at Fort Pangea. To access your vault, visit Sir Jim at Fort Pangea.


[h3] New Steam Achievements[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/83dff6ee5bdb12ef6decaccba4e9437aac950d8e.png[/img]

New Steam Achievements have been added to go along with your Treasure Hunting!
A New Steam Achievement is added to throw a ship in a bottle in the ocean. This can be completed by throwing any ship in the bottle in the ocean. To make it easier, you can obtain a free Salvager Sloop by finishing the new quest Sir Jim’s Sloop which will be given to all players who have finished a certain set of quests. 


[h3] New Falling Coffer Caches[/h3]

New Item “Coffers” can be collected in the ocean in remote areas of the ocean. Coffers are dropped in the ocean from the Pangea Air ship in the sky (story). While you may not always see the Air Ship since it hovers high above the clouds, you may see coffers fall from the sky. Coffers may contain [i]treasure clue[/i]s and some common resources for players. 

Keep an eye out for falling caches from the sky! These caches do disappear, so if you see one fall, go to it. Remember, they are only dropped in the outskirt sections of the map around the smaller islands and far edges of the map. You will only see them as long as your ship isn't idle in the ocean and is moving.

[h3] New First Person Camera Option[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/cf303997827186e2fad4e942928ad4191a280b00.jpg[/img]

Toggle between First and Third Person camera mode to make your gameplay more interesting and immersive! [b]Press the F7 key[/b] when in game to switch views. 

Currently this feature is experimental, and your camera setting will not be saved in preferences. While we intend for both settings to co-exist for all players, let us know which mode you prefer playing in! 

[h3] New Framerate Limit Setting[/h3]

To follow up with our last update, we have added an [b]FPS limit setting to the game’s Home Screen[/b]. This can be chosen before getting into the game. While we will do everything possible to make sure the game runs at optimum levels, it is a good idea to regularly take care of your PC components. Dust and clean your components regularly to avoid overheating issues. If needed, choose proper settings in your NVIDIA or AMD control panels or similar. You can set FPS limits and fine tune other graphic settings via your GPU specific control panels.


[h3]Other Changes[/h3]

[*] All Storage Chests, Player, and Boats now have their slots slightly increased.
[*] Campfires and Iron Stove will now start cooking a recipe if it's already burning fuel
[*] [b]Quests can now be tracked and untracked[/b] from the Objectives menu [O] or similar
[*] Hostile Environment message now shows the consumable to counter the hostile effect
[*] Added new Enemy Ports to shoot in the ocean. A small Pirate Town on a rock!
[*] Destroying Enemy Ports may offer resources and a chance to find Treasure Clues
[*] Added new [b]Stranded Crew[/b] in the ocean near smaller islands
[*] Stranded crew give crew agreements and crew supplies
[*] You can free Stranded Crew with any skeleton key

[*] New usable items such as [b]Bag o' Gold and Mysterious Relic[/b]
These items can be used from player inventory by clicking the item and clicking "Use"
[*] New [b]Seed bags[/b] can be purchased from Tropical & Forest Traders and Shady Merchant
[*] Seed bags can be opened to reveal random seeds from the particular Biome

[*] Added tutorial quests for [C] crafting a campfire and eating energy food
[*] Added visual markers to some starter objectives.
[*] Renamed some quest titles for more clarity
[*] First quest "Message in a Bottle" now gives a Treasure Map
[*] Lost Chest on starter island now gives a Treasure Clue and Shovel
[*] Pressing M for Map now shows Available Quest icons on the map at major hubs
[*] Stone and Copper Key durability has been increased to open more chests
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing Forest Teleport option to show before the Forest objectives were complete. This was causing some lower-level players to get stranded.
[*] Fixed an issue that was causing bamboo walls to not give additional options menu

Currently saved worlds will also benefit from performance optimizations, depending on how many storage entities, and building pieces are placed close to each other.

Overall, there should still be a [b]noticeable boost[/b] in your performance, whether your world is new or old. While we have increased the number of building units that can be rendered effectively in a small area, you may experience some bottlenecks in heavily congested areas with a lot of building and processing units. notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/aa61dde1c6100afd37c899c6353e5dd1c995a96b.png[/img]
[h3]Extended Inventory for Crafting[/h3]
You can now craft items using ingredients stored in nearby storage chests when using a workbench or the player crafting menu (C keybind). 

This feature only affects [b]workbenches [/b]and [b]player crafting menu[/b], but not the tiered processing units such as drying racks, campfires, smokers, etc. Tiered processing units will continue to function (as they were previously) from their own respective storages.

During the crafting process, the crafting system will first check for ingredients in the player inventory, [i]then [/i]the storage chests. If ingredients are stored in different chests, the crafting system will progressively check for ingredients in each nearby chest and take what is needed, prioritizing the player’s inventory first.

[i]Note that if similar crafting ingredients are spread out in multiple chests, it will take from a random nearby chest [/i]

For players who prefer a classic crafting system, "crafting from nearby chest" feature can be turned on and off using the F9 key (Experimental and Subject to change)

Several publishers were interested in our project, and it was clear to us that our project had outgrown our small indie team.

Freedom Games stood out clearly because of their resolve to help small indie teams, their extensive background in classic gaming, and their drive to ensure that the games offer something deeper than just the first couple hours (something that has eroded over the last decade). We like in-depth games and wanted a publisher that shared the same passion for our project, as we had. We believe that our partnership with Freedom Games will thrive in the coming years.

notes.title: Alpha Update - Ship Fittings & Ghost Ships!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43050545/44d81f9149cfffe117839904315cabc0bdb0f369.png[/img]

[b]Ghost Ship Encounter[/b]
Ghost ships can be found roaming in lightning storms or tempests near maelstroms. Defeating them can provide items of great benefits. Ghost ships deal extensive 'Bio Damage' so bring the right ship that can handle storms well and is resistant to Bio Damage type.

[b]Introducing Ship Fittings[/b]
Fit your ship with Bulkhead Upgrades of various tier levels. Each ship in the game has special Tier benefits. For example, interceptor class ships (such as Naval Cutter) are resistant to [i]Bio Damage[/i]
Cruiser class ships (such as Soul Queen) are resistant to [i]Frost Damage[/i] and so forth. Check the blueprints of your ship for more details.

Installing a bulkhead in your ship will boost its tier level and make the ship even more resistant to its specialized damage type. For instance, installing a bulkhead in a Naval Cutter will make it more resilient to lightning storm damage and ghost ships. Making it an ideal ship to take to these encounters.

[*] Loot items dropped in ocean can now be picked up at a larger range while mounted. Allowing you to press F while mounted on ships, while the loot beam is under you.

notes.title: Demo Update: QOL changes and FPS Camera optimization
notes.content:
[b]Usability Improvements and Support for different playstyles[/b]

Thank you so much for your patience and feedback as we addressed some issues with the FPS camera mode. The FPS camera mode was mostly experimental when the demo was first released. We have made some stability and usability changes to this mode.  We understand that everyone has different preferences when it comes to camera movement. Our eyes are peeled on feedback, and it is our utmost priority to make sure we accommodate as many playstyles as possible. With this in mind, we have made some improvements!

[i]Interaction Changes:[/i]
[list]
[*] It is now easier to interact with objects using left click and double click while in the fps camera mode. You can interact with objects such as campfires, drying racks, etc. by simply double-clicking on them while in the fps camera mode. We still support E to interact on items in fps mode, however, point and click is the preferred and stable playstyle.
[/list]

[i]Attack Changes:[/i]
[list]
[*] You can now left click to attack monster character targets when your mouse aim is on the monster characters. Left click attack system will only work when your aim on the monster characters is accurate. Clicking outside the hit box will yield no results.
[/list]

We still support auto attack on double clicks and free attack mode such as "V". 
These modes are helpful when you prefer the fixed camera playstyle. 
Feel free to pick the playstyle you enjoy!

[i]New Quests![/i]
Two new Raft quests have been added to the message in a bottle.

[i]QOL Changes:[/i]
[list]
[*] You spoke, we heard! You can now hop on the turtles to ride them!
(We were surprised by just how many requests we received for the above!)
[*] Chopping stump now makes firewood quicker. Also added visual aids to the chopping stump.
[*] Reduced leather requirement for the raft.
[*] Water now gives slightly more thirst instantly.
[*] The copper sword can now be crafted at an earlier level.
[*] An additional fish pool now spawns.
[*] You can now find more driftwood logs on the shores.
[*] Tooltips of certain items have been updated to provide more hints.
[*] Campfire, Drying Rack, and Chicken now drop items properly when full.
[*] Steamed Clam and Steamed Crab can now be cooked in the basic campfire.
[*] Target bars now properly reset on death.
[/list]

notes.content:
[b]Usability update[/b]
Fixed a small issue that was causing conflicting interactions with UI.
It is now easier to interact with items using left click, and double click.


[b]Balance Changes[/b]
Sprint now automatically turns off upon stopping to conserve energy, hunger and thirst. Sprint must now be[u] toggled on while moving[/u] to speed up the movement. It has no effect when toggled on while standing still.
